definitions.explanation: A device for sharpening pencils, whether hand-held, desktop, or electric.

examples.japanese: {鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧。
⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: An electric pencil sharpener is convenient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧おか⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I need to buy a pencil sharpener before starting elementary school.

notes:
{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り is a compound of ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧ (pencil) and ⟦{削|けず}り→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ (shaving/sharpening), referring to any device used to sharpen pencils.

TYPES:
- ⟦{手動|しゅどう}→手動：12890_shudou⟧{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り: manual pencil sharpener (hand-held or crank)
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り: electric pencil sharpener

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧: to sharpen with a pencil sharpener
- {鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a pencil sharpener

CULTURAL NOTE:
A standard item on elementary school supply lists ({入学準備|にゅうがくじゅんび}) in Japan, where pencils are still widely used. Japanese students often use hand-crank desktop models at home and small portable ones at school.
